question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever been in a photo shoot before?

nodes.text: Autumn follows him down the court, snapping a photo of him as he approaches the basket!
Before it fades, she sees a clear image of Ben in the midst of a flurry of hands and uniforms! The look on Ben's face is one of pure focus.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They're okay. He's smiling in them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's bad?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: 'Happiness' isn't the trait I was going for. But maybe that's okay. He can be displaying a `strong` resistance to sadness.
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Happiness' isn't the trait I was going for. But maybe that's okay. He can be displaying a [color=#3b78e2][i]strong[/i][/color] resistance to sadness.

nodes.text: They hear the warning bell that signals classes start in ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'd better hit the showers. If anyone's late to Mr. Dean's class, he gives pop quizzes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Exactly. Talk to you later.
$ZOE turns to Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are the photos?
$ZOE and Owen exchange glances as Autumn satellites around them, her camera poised.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, okay. How are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good. You? Any problems with your life?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't call being really busy a 'problem'...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It must be. I barely see you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I barely see you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've been doubling my efforts in basketball. With the game coming up, I spend most of my time in the gym. And if not there, then at the basketball court near my home.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I like to practice shooting around at night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Is that what you've been doing after practice?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, what else did you think I'd do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know. Probably Owen things.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Owen things, huh? I guess I have been doing those.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you? What about what you've been up to?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Social Chair. I've been planning this Art Showcase, and it's eating up a bunch of time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've had to skip a few cheerleading practices, and Maria and the rest of them aren't very happy with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to disappoint them. But I just have so many other duties. I'm already thinking about what's going on for Valentine's Day, and it's only January!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, don't beat yourself up. You're an important public official now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am?

He puts a comforting arm around her, and Autumn lifts her camera. The angle of his face, and his serious, confident gaze reads perfectly. She snaps off a few shots, wondering if she should include more of $ZOE.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Great! The perfect show of emotional strength by being a support for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know what we'd do without you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you even know what my job entails?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Making posters? And you're definitely doing a good job of that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As for cheerleading practices, you'll figure it out. Social Chair may take up a lot of time now, but you'll adjust.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I believe that you can do anything, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen.
$ZOE and Owen exchange glances as Autumn satellites around them, her camera poised.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, okay. How are your classes going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that exciting. Mr. Dean's still asking me about symbolism in novels. But Mrs. Fitzpootie is pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really loving that finance elective I'm taking. We get to create our own fake businesses and try to turn a fake profit.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What venture are you starting?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE's Cup and Cake Cupcake Bake Shop.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha ha...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm still sad that you didn't take the class with us. Do you like Psychology?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's good. For a class. At least there aren't any more crazy projects with Paige, which is what I'm thankful for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah!
Autumn lifts her camera to take a picture, but the smile on Owen's face is ruining the effect.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Too bad I'm trying to see 'strength', not happiness.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Autumn, what should we talk about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Your classes! Talk about your classes!
Owen leaves the workout station, opens his water bottle, and takes a long swig.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, just one more picture.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The picture I just took shows you doing something strenuous, but it would be nice to see another kind of strength.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Something less physical. More emotional.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh! I have an idea. Sometimes when a person talks with someone they're close to, opportunities for emotional strength rise to the surface! You two talk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: About what?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Rowing machine it is.
Owen positions himself on the moving seat, places his hands on the fake oars, and starts a program.
Autumn holds up her camera and takes a shot, but the picture doesn't show Owen's strength as he easily pulls back on the 'oars'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're making it look too easy, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe it's just my incredible strength.
He rows until the end of the program. Autumn takes one last photo for good measure.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess this will have to do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not `bad`. It's just that you don't look like you're working very hard.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color]. It's just that you don't look like you're working very hard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you going to use that picture? Because I don't know if I want to look like a slacker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You look fine to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. Never mind. Use the picture. I just hope everyone reacts the same way $ZOE does.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: 'Battle ropes' sound dramatic enough.
Owen steps over to a thick, white rope that's been looped around a pole to create two loose ends.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's not fair, you know. You can put 'battle' in front of anything, and it'd sound cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Battle kitten?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Exactly. See what I'm saying?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So how do these ropes work?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Watch and learn.
Owen grips each of the ends of the rope and begins to furiously lift and lower his arms. The ropes move quickly like snakes on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My arms are tired just by looking at him. He definitely looks strong.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Seriously.
Autumn brings up her camera and snaps a photo. She catches Owen mid-swing, the photo capturing the sweat on his brow and the defined muscle of his arms as they pump the heavy ropes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Perfect. You look like you're working out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh good. I wouldn't want people to think otherwise.
Autumn can't decide! She says the first thing she thinks of.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The, uh, boat thing?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All I need are Owen's photos... And then I'll be ready for the Art Showcase!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we have all morning. Want to meet up right before school? Ben said Owen works out in the weight room early.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sure. Sounds great.
Autumn turns back to her photos as $ZOE checks her phone. It's nearly dinner time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it's way too late to go to that cupcake party...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope I didn't miss anything...
The next morning...
$ZOE and Autumn meet in the very busy weight room. Owen is standing near the drinking fountain, filling up a water bottle.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE! It's nice to see you. Are you going to work out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I'm helping Autumn. She needs to take photos for the Art Showcase, and we were hoping you wouldn't mind being in a few.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The theme of these photos is going to be `strength.` If there's somewhere in here I could get pictures of you working out, that'd be great.
nodes.text_bbcode: The theme of these photos is going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]strength.[/i][/color] If there's somewhere in here I could get pictures of you working out, that'd be great.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Did that seem creepy? I didn't mean it to be creepy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's okay. As long as you're not panting while you're taking the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll try to keep our tongues in our mouths.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I was just finishing up, but I'd be happy to squeeze in one more exercise. In fact, you can choose.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Choose?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Which exercise? The rowing machine or the battle ropes?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...
And another photo of Ben wackily making a granny shot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't see that one. It's... Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's being more 'wacky' in this picture than 'focused'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He is focusing on making that shot...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah...
Autumn sees a blurry picture of Ben...
And a bad photo of Emily and Ben with Emily's head turning away from the camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That doesn't look very `clear`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... That doesn't look very [color=#3b78e2][i]clear[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can still tell it's Emily, though... She has a very recognizable... Arm.
$ZOE comes rushing back up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry about that. Amanda just sent me a bunch of texts about a 'popcorn party' tomorrow before school. I tried calling her, but she won't pick up.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A popcorn party?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, sometimes the day before a game, we psych ourselves up with a fun snack... We've had fruit parties, granola bar parties, and Keith's horrible muffin parties before...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That sounds festive. Are you going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... They're fun, but I'd like to help you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for all your help, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course. Do you have any idea who you want your next model to be?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Not yet. But since I've got photos that show 'passion' and 'focus', I'd like to round it out with a different trait.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Something that can also be slightly physical. Like... Like 'strength'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Strength, huh? You know, if you take it literally, you could use Owen as a subject.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen plays football `and` basketball. He's definitely strong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen plays football [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] basketball. He's definitely strong.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd love to take a picture of Owen for the Showcase. Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure. He usually leaves pretty soon after practice. Probably to see Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But if you can wait until tomorrow, Owen is usually in the weight room right before school.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'll find him tomorrow then. Thanks, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks.
Later, in the art studio...
$ZOE watches Autumn develop her pictures and takes a look at them as they dry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? How'd we do?
Autumn looks up at the photos. She sees...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I pulled off a lot of pranks in my time. Mostly in the name of school spirit. Like, during one of the football games, I turned Wilson High's mascot badger green!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Aww... What about the poor badger?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's fine. The dye was very safe, and it wore off after a couple days.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I think I can use your prankster past as inspiration for your second photo.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Pranking isn't something I do that much anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ever since I started dating Emily... I have to be on my best behavior.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's still a part of you though, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... But I don't want to fake prank just for the camera.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe you can do something else? Something silly related to basketball?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's always the granny shot...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, do that!

Ben takes the ball in both hands, squatting as he brings the ball between his legs and heaves it up towards the basket! Autumn takes the picture. When she looks down to see it, Ben looks both wacky and uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm, wrong direction, I think. Ben doesn't seem happy here. Maybe I shouldn't have pushed him to pose as something he's not.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh well, there's no time to think about it now.
Autumn lowers her camera.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, man, it was embarrassing. I was really uptight back in the day. All I cared about were grades and getting into the advanced classes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't think about girls or parties or anything social.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whoa, that's a strange turnaround from the Ben we all know today.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know, right? But even though I've changed a lot on the surface, I know the old Ben is still around.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe that's where I get my real focus for basketball. From him.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Do you still like science?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. I don't take classes quite as seriously as I used to, but it's still a fascinating field.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I've found a way to merge science and my social life together. I created a light machine for some of my parties. People get a real kick out of it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you ask?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I think your science background will serve wonderfully as inspiration for your second photo. You light up when you talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Although, I'm not quite sure how to show that in the photo. Would it be cheesy to put you in front of a chemistry set?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe I can hold a beaker? You know, I think there's some old lab equipment in the gym's storage closet from $ZOE's haunted house.
Ben finds the storage closet and takes out a makeshift lab set of beakers, thin clear tubes, and graduated cylinders.
He poses with the set as he tells Autumn about some of his other inventions, and Autumn takes a picture.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is great.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm glad I picked science. It really is part of Ben's identity.
Autumn loses sight of him on the court!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Where is he?
She looks around frantically and finally finds Ben at the center of a cluster of players. She snaps a photo, but it's blurry!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't tell if that's his hand or his foot!
Autumn snaps the photo at the perfect time! A moment later, Emily's secret smile as she leans into Ben's embrace fades from view.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That definitely shows passion...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Em, you look... Not at all ready to go to homeroom.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. But I was doing a photo shoot for Autumn and $ZOE. I'll get dressed and come right out!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't move!
Emily disappears into the locker room, and Ben gives the other two girls a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I'm stuck here.
He gestures to the camera in Autumn's arms.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is this for the Art Showcase?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. Autumn's retaking all her photos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I realized my artistic vision was not very well-received by the subjects of my photos.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I heard about what happened. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's all right. Hopefully my new pictures won't cause such a scandal.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you've taken pictures of Emily. Who else is on your list?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So far that's it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll model for you! I've got basketball practice after school. Heh. You can take shots of me taking shots!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Perfect! I'll be there!
After school, Autumn and $ZOE walk into the gym where basketball practice is taking place.
They sit in the bleachers and watch for a couple minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wondering what to photograph?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. Wondering why all our money goes into sports instead of art programs.
Autumn watches as Spencer blocks a shot at the basket by slapping it down.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Take that, suckers!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's not maybe the most `cultural` event in the world, but there is something uplifting about everyone watching the same game.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's not maybe the most [color=#3b78e2][i]cultural[/i][/color] event in the world, but there is something uplifting about everyone watching the same game.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A tradition that goes back to the gladiators in ancient times.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is... Not what I would have thought of first. But yes, in a way. People watching sports share the same experience. There's something nice about that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You have a very positive outlook on life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently, I eat glitter for breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, look, there's Ben!
$ZOE waves, but Ben is concentrating on the game.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's so focused.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you can use that emotion for your photos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I was just thinking that myself. Good idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe hanging around you has developed my inner artist...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I have no idea how you're going to show 'focus'...
Ben and his team cluster around the other team's basket. Ben fakes a pass to the right, cuts left, and goes in for a layup!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Right there. Did you see that move? He looked absolutely determined. If he does it again, I'm going to try for a picture.
Autumn jumps down from the bleachers to get closer, and sure enough, Ben tries the same play again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I just need to track him, so I can get the best shot! He fakes a pass, cuts inside, and goes for the layup!
Autumn jogs courtside, following the action closely with the camera's lens. She watches as Ben...
Autumn snaps the roll in and takes the photo. The image of Emily's secret smile as she leans into Ben's embrace fades from view.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That definitely shows passion...
Autumn fumbles! When she finally snaps the roll in, she takes a picture...
But the moment is gone.
Autumn sees she has a bad angle of Emily's head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot.
Autumn fumbles! When she finally snaps the roll in, she takes a picture...
But the moment is gone.
Autumn sees she has a bad angle of Emily's head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I think I've got something that will `work.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think I've got something that will [color=#3b78e2][i]work.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't take any pictures at all!
Autumn snaps off three quick pictures of Emily striding their way.
Emily grabs a towel off the bench near Autumn and starts drying herself off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Did you get anything good?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'll have to see when it's developed, but...
Autumn snaps a photo of Emily as she climbs out of the pool. She glances down at it, and realizes it's of Emily looking down at the cement floor.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Not the best...
Autumn doesn't take the picture.
Emily touches the far wall, ending her lap. She pulls herself out of the pool.
Autumn snaps the photo.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `that` was perfect! The look on her face was fantastic!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was perfect! The look on her face was fantastic!

nodes.text: Autumn waits.
Emily reaches one end of the pool and maneuvers under water.
When she pops to the surface, Emily re-orients herself, her body falling into position. She's faster now as she barrels down the lane...
Autumn can see a small smile curve across Emily's lips for the briefest moment...
Autumn snaps the photo. For a second, the image of Emily's perfectly straight arm hovers in the viewfinder then vanishes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I got her face, but her arm's kind of putting it in shadow...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Not yet...
Emily resurfaces on her back, gliding through the water. Her arms dip low beneath the water, then lift high again, pinwheeling around...
$ZOE looks at the photo over Autumn's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh! That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but I can't see her face that clearly...
Autumn waits.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You should be helping with `everything`... But fine. Come to the practices you have time for.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should be helping with [color=#3b78e2][i]everything[/i][/color]... But fine. Come to the practices you have time for.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Amanda will text you about them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Maria.
$ZOE and Autumn turn and trudge out of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How am I going to find new people to take pictures of?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, it won't be that bad. How about that guy?
$ZOE points to a boy skateboarding down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmmm... No. It can't be just anybody.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The point of my exhibit was to put two pictures of the same person side by side to display a certain trait like passion or ferocity or a holistic compassion for the entirety of mankind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... A lot to ask for a photo.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe so. But at the very least, I'd like subjects with depth to them, people who love the things they do. That's when you see someone's true character come out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The cheerleaders were perfect because, well, they love being cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If it's athletes you want, what about the swim team? They're probably finishing up swim practice now. You can photograph them right before class!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sure! Just let me grab my camera!
You are now playing as Autumn.
Autumn fiddles with the settings on an old camera as $ZOE leads the way to the swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I've ever seen a camera like that before. Is it new?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Actually, it's old. It's my mother's camera. She gave it to me before she passed away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's okay. It's been ten years. I've... Gotten used to it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But my mother was a photographer. This was her favorite camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That must make it special.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It is. In more ways than one. The pictures that come out of it are really unique.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, first, it's the only older camera I've ever heard of that holds the picture you take in its viewfinder for a slight second after you take a shot. It makes it easy to tell what my photos are going to look like.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And second, it gives every picture a 'soft focus'. It's when things look a little dream-like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh right. I saw that in your cheerleader pictures. It made everything look slightly blurry. But in a fun way.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's... One way to put it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I don't really know what I'm talking about when it comes to art.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You don't have to know anything. Art is part of who we are. When you see anything that makes you feel a certain way, it's art.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So me freaking out over a pop quiz is art?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, `that` might just be life.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] might just be life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh.
And that's when $ZOE's phone buzzes with an incoming text. She reads it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What is it? Cheer-mergency?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Amanda texted me saying they're having a... Cupcake party after school?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What happened to the last-minute cheer practice you might have to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe they didn't have to revise the routines and are now celebrating.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, Amanda did also text me to 'bring the party hats', so that must mean everything's been resolved.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like I can skip the after-school meeting after all. This is more important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the swim center's right up here.
$ZOE and Autumn walk into the swim center. The pool is empty, save for one lone girl swimming an extra couple laps.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmm, I thought the swim team was bigger than this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder where everyone is...
In the pool, Emily surfaces and climbs out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. Are you looking for Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of. Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, practice ended. They're all in the locker room changing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm guessing they won't want to have their picture taken in there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not unless you want your theme to be 'scandal'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That'll definitely make my art show popular with the male half of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Pictures? For yearbook?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For an Art Showcase. Autumn here wants some new subjects for her photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now that I think about it... Autumn, you said you wanted someone with depth and passion. Emily's got both!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'd love to, if that's okay with you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure... But I have to warn you. I'm no good at posing for pictures. You should see my yearbook photos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If you don't like posing, you shoudn't pose. I enjoy taking revealing candids more anyway. You just do what you do best.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And I hear you're our best swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I try. Want me to do a few laps in the pool? I have a couple minutes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That would be great! Just... Pretend I'm not here.
Emily begins stretching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do you look for when you're taking pictures?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The right time. As someone who wants to capture life, every single moment is a photo opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel like I'd be taking pictures all the time if I thought like that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this camera takes a special kind of film.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like actual film?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can only take three pictures before I have to reload, so I'm pretty careful about the shots I take. Otherwise, I'd be spending a ton of money on old film.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So I have to be really patient about waiting for the perfect shot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the perfect moment here?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going to use Emily as a subject, I should kind of know what emotion I want her to express. In this case, I want to show how passionate she is, how much she cares about something.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So I'm looking for a great moments that show she's happy and proud to be where she is....
They turn to watch Emily as she hops into the pool and positions herself against the far ledge. Autumn raises her camera.
Emily pulls herself close to the pool edge, then she springs up and out!
Autumn sees the arc of Emily's body as she dives into her backstroke.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love cheerleading, and I'm sorry about the entire mess with Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I swear I'll practice all the routines on my own, and I'll make up what I've missed.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Practicing by yourself is `not` the same as practicing with the group, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Practicing by yourself is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] the same as practicing with the group, but...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: At least you're trying. I thought Social Chair was taking up your entire life.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I can't say that it's not time consuming... But I'm just trying my best to do both.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just make sure you're not sacrificing one for the other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will. And I'll try to help with whatever I can.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're not even trying to stick with us, $ZOE. It's like Social Chair is the only thing that matters to you.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just remember that you were a cheerleader `way` before you were ever Social Chair.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just remember that you were a cheerleader [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] before you were ever Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And you can't get away with skipping practice all the time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. I need to help the team. But I also need to help Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I swear, I'll learn all the dances and routines later. And I'll try to help with whatever I can.
Maria glares at her... Then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, exactly!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I don't think your subjects see it the way you do. Maria thought the photos made her look ugly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... More or less. I meant for it to be 'despondent', 'passionate', and 'fierce'... But what you said is close enough.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I don't think your subjects see it the way you do. Maria thought the photos made her look ugly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wow, I guess I did worse with my art exhibit than I thought... No wonder people hate my work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, Autumn, it's not like that at all. It's just... Your subjects don't see it the way you do. Maria thought the photos made her look ugly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Some people care too much about appearances when they're beautiful just the way they are.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I guess I see what you're saying.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I had no idea. I didn't mean to hurt anyone!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't think these pictures were unflattering. I thought they were honest and real.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It wasn't Keith looking depressed, it was the sadness and longing on his face.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And it wasn't just a picture of Nicole making out with a guy, but rather, Nicole displaying such raw enthusiasm for romance.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And Maria isn't ugly or contorted. She's fierce and passionate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't think that's how they wanted to be seen. They could be a little less honest.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't use these for the Art Showcase now. I'll have to redo them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you have time?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe. Do you think the cheerleaders will be up for another round of pictures?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... I guess it couldn't hurt to ask...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The cheerleaders might blame Autumn for Lindsay being banned from cheerleading... This could be a bad idea.
$ZOE and Autumn find the cheerleaders in a huddle in the gym. They turn to $ZOE as she approaches.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE, there you are! We've been waiting for you!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I texted you a bunch of times!
$ZOE looks down at her phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got your text, but I had no idea that 'asdf' was actually a message...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... It means 'A Situation, Dash Fast!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, what's the `photographer` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, what's the [color=#3b78e2][i]photographer[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.text: She nods at Autumn who blushes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I... I had a favor to ask you guys. $ZOE told me that you weren't happy with the photos I was using for the showcase...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That picture made me look `gross.` And I don't look gross. Ever.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? That picture made me look [color=#3b78e2][i]gross.[/i][/color] And I don't look gross. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, my photo did show my best side, but my skin was really blotchy.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I didn't mind my picture. But... It is kind of awkward because the guy I was making out with turned out to be a major jerk! He and I are `way` over.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't mind my picture. But... It is kind of awkward because the guy I was making out with turned out to be a major jerk! He and I are [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] over.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Too bad. We almost lasted a week too!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Can you `not` show those in your dumb exhibit thing?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] show those in your dumb exhibit thing?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I've already decided not to. $ZOE told me how you felt, so that's why I want to hold another photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were hoping she could take some pictures of you guys again.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm in! I've been practicing my pout.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know if I can find a guy to make out with on such short notice, but...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, absolutely not. Nicole, Keith... You can't either.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah, we don't have time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time? Time for what?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You don't know? Why do you think we were trying to get ahold of you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Lindsay can't cheer. She's been suspended.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. It's sad, but she really did deserve it after what she did to Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whatever. She may have deserved it, but that doesn't change the fact that Lindsay's gone.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Now we need to re-choreograph all the routines for one less cheerleader, and then we need to practice...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: There's no time for a photo shoot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Will have to wait.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to find new subjects... But that will make it hard to finish everything by tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can help you. We'll find people.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... I hate to burst your bubble, but we need you right now, $ZOE. You're a cheerleader, and you're part of the emergency practices too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Taylor ordered me to supervise Autumn's project since the Art Showcase was my idea.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So you're not going to make it to any practices? Honestly, $ZOE, since you've become Social Chair, you haven't really been `around.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're not going to make it to any practices? Honestly, $ZOE, since you've become Social Chair, you haven't really been [color=#3b78e2][i]around.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, I know... But I swear...

options.label: I'll come after I'm done with Autumn's project.

nodes.text: $ZOE stutters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: B... Berserk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Maria is...
$ZOE stumbles over her answer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, boy crazy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nicole is...
$ZOE hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, pathetic?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is why I'm happy to tell you that the Art Showcase is back on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As long as you turn your photos in to Taylor before the office closes tomorrow evening, then you're good!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's wonderful! I've never been in a real show before...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But there's just one thing... What about the person who ruined my art?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Taylor asked me to figure out who it was, and I did.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Who was it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay? I hardly know her! Why would `she` do that to my pictures?
nodes.text_bbcode: Lindsay? I hardly know her! Why would [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] do that to my pictures?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I talked to her, she was angry that you didn't include her in the Showcase. To her, it was like saying she wasn't popular enough.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I looked through her pictures, but they just didn't capture what I wanted. Maria, Keith, and Nicole's pictures showed intense emotion, so I went with theirs instead.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I wish she would have just talked to me... Instead of sending me hate mail and ruining my art.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay wasn't the one who sent you the hate mail. That was Maria.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maria didn't like the photos either?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you `knew.` I mean, those pictures are pretty unflattering.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you [color=#3b78e2][i]knew.[/i][/color] I mean, those pictures are pretty unflattering.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They are?

Autumn opens her laptop and finds her Art Showcase file. Three pictures pop up: one of Keith staring sadly into the camera, one of Nicole about to make out with a guy, and the last of Maria's face contorted with anger.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I wanted to capture raw emotion on camera. Do you get what I was trying to convey?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keith is...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You mean lame, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just if you told me you had a picture of grass, I'd probably think it was a pretty boring photo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But these are taken at such an interesting angle that it's kind of cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's amazing what you made with such ordinary subject matter.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess I like to find pictures of the `extra` in the ordinary.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I like to find pictures of the [color=#3b78e2][i]extra[/i][/color] in the ordinary.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do a good job of it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Really? What do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... Like the colors in this grass picture... They're so... `Green.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... Like the colors in this grass picture... They're so... [color=#3b78e2][i]Green.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's because they are green.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this fire truck! It's so red.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Do you know what abstract means?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I get it. It's all right if you don't see my vision and find them unappealing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! They're wonderful! Even if I don't know how to describe them properly... I think people would love these!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And on the bright side, Lindsay's not going to ruin Autumn's art anytime soon... Which means the Art Showcase is back on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh great! Autumn will be so happy to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me? I guess I'm happy too! Not only will I be able to help Autumn, but her art is going to be a big draw to the Showcase!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the revenues go straight to my Social Chair budget!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be able to plan dances and parties and socials and--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Easy there, Little Miss Plan Cakes. There's a catch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She has to turn her photos in to me by the end of day tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why? The Art Showcase isn't for another two weeks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Which is about how long it takes for the school board to review all exhibit materials and approve them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't make the rules. If Autumn wants her work shown, she'll have to turn it in tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But her photos will only take five minutes to review.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So will all the other projects they have to look at. Look, I'm not trying to sabotage Autumn, but this is how the process works. Is it going to be a problem?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it'll be fine...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! Supervise it. Get it done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope Autumn's still around! We've got work to do!
$ZOE rushes over to the photo lab and is relieved to find Autumn, who is hanging photos by pegs on a clothesline.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn! Thank goodness you're here!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I am. Look, sorry I haven't been around much lately, but I... I needed to clear my head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I couldn't handle seeing my pictures destroyed like that, and I kind of broke down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry that you had to go through that. How are you now?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Better. I feel better when I can express myself, so I went out on a photo shoot yesterday. I just developed these.
Autumn points to the hanging photos. $ZOE draws closer to examine them.
In one photo, she sees blades of grass fluttering in the wind as people walk through a park.
In another, she sees the bright red of a fire truck illuminated by the lights of a nearby street lamp.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The subjects of your photos seem so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean... What Lindsay did was wrong, but... I kind of feel bad that she has detention.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of my fault.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what, you want her to `not` serve detention?
nodes.text_bbcode: So what, you want her to [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] serve detention?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, way to be a flip-flopper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A flip-flopper?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. One who changes her mind all the time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or, I guess one who also wears flip-flops...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But either way... You made the call on Lindsay. You shouldn't regret it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't regret it. She should get detention for destroying Autumn's photos.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, she's going to miss a lot of practices. And we need her for stunts.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That is too bad. But it's part of the job.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it needed to be done.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least you made the right call.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now, we have some prints to deliver.
In the Student President's office, Taylor is just putting on her jacket to leave when $ZOE and Autumn burst in, breathless.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't leave! We're here! We're here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Geez, talk about cutting it close. I was just about to count you out. What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I felt like I learned a valuable lesson today. People care a lot about how they're perceived.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And if you ignore that, then you devalue them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You were late because of a life lesson?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That and she retook all her photos.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about the pictures?
Autumn shows off her mounted photos.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, these look professional.
Taylor skims over Emily's passionate face, the focus in Ben's eyes, the quiet strength of Owen, and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You took pictures of Lindsay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't want any bad blood between us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's probably a wise move. You don't want to be enemies with crazy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And there's another lesson learned.
Taylor nods at the model-perfect photos of Lindsay on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Her photos seem a little different than the others.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I like how her photos turned out. Not my usual style.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, she looks pretty, just like she wanted.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, she does. Good work, Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks. I just hope I don't offend anyone this time around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll see what everyone else thinks at the Art Showcase. Until then.
Taylor grabs her bag and heads out of the office.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Until then!
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 3: Showcase Sabotage, Part 2!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 4, Episode 3: Showcase Sabotage, Part 2![/b]

Magic School: Book 2 is here!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why should we care about the school?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because you're in it?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, $ZOE. I mean, why should `we` care? You're always planning a dance or a party or a showcase...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, $ZOE. I mean, why should [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] care? You're always planning a dance or a party or a showcase...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you're helping everyone else `except` for us!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you're helping everyone else [color=#3b78e2][i]except[/i][/color] for us!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: When are the cheerleaders going to get a special event?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, after--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah. `After`. After everyone else.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. [color=#3b78e2][i]After[/i][/color]. After everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know what? I can't kick you off the team, but if you can't even bother to `try` to make practice, don't bother coming at all!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what? I can't kick you off the team, but if you can't even bother to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to make practice, don't bother coming at all!

nodes.text: Maria turns on her heel and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whoa. Sorry if I caused you any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's kind of right. I haven't been thinking about cheerleading since I became Social Chair. But I'll figure it out later.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do her photos have to do with us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What Lindsay did doesn't make us look good. It reflects badly on the entire cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If the Art Showcase is canceled, we look like bullies.
Maria sighs.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah. That's true...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that it doesn't really excuse me from missing practice, but I swear, after this, I'll try to figure it all out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Fine. Do what you have to do. But the team expects you to know your routines by the basketball game, so you'd better learn all of them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll study them all.
Maria steps aside to let them pass.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whoa, that was close. It was like watching a giant panda bear about to leap on a yak!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do panda bears eat yaks?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know, but it's a fun image.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right. Carnage. Fun. Whee.
$ZOE hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Um, help the school?
Autumn bursts out of the room, carefully holding each completed print.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Success?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes! Let's get these photos to Taylor!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE and Autumn dash into the hallway, each carefully carrying one of the new prints.
They're almost at the office when they run into Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE! We need to talk!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we talk in a minute? It's really important that--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I'm not waiting another second. You've been blowing off all the emergency meetings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought we didn't have any! Amanda said they were all popcorn parties!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's the `code word` for `emergency dance meeting` which you would know if you went to the first `cupcake party` to begin with!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the [color=#3b78e2][i]code word[/i][/color] for [color=#3b78e2][i]emergency dance meeting[/i][/color] which you would know if you went to the first [color=#3b78e2][i]cupcake party[/i][/color] to begin with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then why did Amanda ask me to bring party hats?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That's what she calls the megaphones.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Which you'd know if you came to practice `last` week. Geez, $ZOE. Everything's more important than the cheerleading team to you, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Which you'd know if you came to practice [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] week. Geez, $ZOE. Everything's more important than the cheerleading team to you, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's not!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yesterday you said that you'd try to make it to at least `some` of the practices, but you haven't come to any!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yesterday you said that you'd try to make it to at least [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] of the practices, but you haven't come to any!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I needed to make sure something got done for the Art Showcase and...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Stop! Just stop it! You're always doing something for Social Chair, and we let it go before because you're our friend.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But now we really need you, and it's clear that you've deserted us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's not like Autumn needs you around to hold her hand. She takes pictures fine without you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel awful about not making it to practice... And I know I haven't been there lately, but this is important. It's...
Autumn comes out of the darkroom, dejected.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I made a mistake. The photos are ruined. I can't do Lindsay's exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is a shame. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh well. Maybe the Art Showcase wasn't meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what? But what about the other photos? Ben's, Emily's, and Owen's photos look great!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I know, but... I can't submit them. If Lindsay finds out that I went ahead with their pictures, but not hers, it'll be like the first photos all over again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: She'll be `so` upset.
nodes.text_bbcode: She'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what? You don't have to bow down to her. You should still be in the Art Showcase. Forget about her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't. If she retaliates and does something to my photos--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then she's won. And she'll be mad at you anyway.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but it'll be worse. I can't see my photos ruined again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. I'm withdrawing. I'm sorry, $ZOE. Tell Taylor I tried.
Autumn walks out of the classroom, her camera in hand. She hangs her head and, in her heart of hearts...
She knows she's failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Developer, stopper, and fixer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just a few more minutes... And I'm done!
A tense half hour later, Autumn dries the photo and holds it carefully in her hand.
Even in the dim light, she can see that the picture's come out perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot! That's not what I wanted to do!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the photo. She looks at the finished product...
And sees splotches of light and shadow ruin the effect of the picture...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no...
Autumn absentmindedly sticks it in the fixer solution!
Autumn dumps in twelve cups of water.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I feel like the tray is too full... But there's no going back now...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's it!
Autumn dumps in eight cups of water and sticks the photo in.
A few minutes later, Lindsay's smiling face shows up on the photo paper...
Autumn fumbles and dumps so much water into the tray that it overflows!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the film. She looks at the finished photo...
The picture of Lindsay has come out, but instead of a dream-like blur, Lindsay's face looks fuzzy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot... I put it down the wrong way!
Autumn places the strip emulsion side down and prepares for the next step.
Autumn flips the negatives back and forth trying to see which is the shiny side...
But it slips out of her hands and lands in the solution film shiny side down!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That seems fine...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay... But what about your other photo?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: My 'other photo'?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Everyone else I've taken a picture of has done two different shots. If your first is 'pretty', what's your second?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Duh. It's also 'pretty'. Just take the picture from a different angle.
Autumn considers this then nods.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All right. Give me 'pretty.'
Lindsay tilts her chin down and gives Autumn's camera an intense, sultry look. Autumn snaps the picture.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Great. Try a different pose.
Lindsay then torques her body, so she's looking at Autumn's camera over her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And again.
The third picture shows Lindsay blowing a kiss at the camera.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And that's it. Thanks, Lindsay. You'll see your photos at the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Great. You know, this was actually not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Anyway, bye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She is... Not who I thought she was.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, that's probably the closest I've ever heard you come to an insult.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. I'm not nice all the time.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, you are. Now come on, we have some film to develop.
$ZOE checks her phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have a little more than an hour before Taylor's office closes down.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Cutting it close, but we can make it! The photos can dry on the way.
$ZOE and Autumn rush into the art studio.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All we need to do is develop the pictures and run them over to Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If you want to help, can you put the photos I've already developed into frames?
Autumn gestures to a work table that has printed photos of Emily, Ben, and Owen. Empty frames are propped up against the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds like so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Only you would think framing photos is that exciting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you? You're the photographer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I do. But not as much as I care about the picture itself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Makes sense. Well, don't sweat it. I'll get these photos framed. Go develop the rest!
Autumn brings the roll of film into the darkroom and shuts off the lights.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger `emulsion side down` for it to come out right... That's the dull side!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, first things first... I make the negatives, and then I mount them on my enlarger [color=#3b78e2][i]emulsion side down[/i][/color] for it to come out right... That's the dull side!

nodes.text: Working as fast as she can, Autumn develops the film, creating negatives for her photos.
Then, Autumn turns to her enlarger and mounts the first negative of Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: It's better than 'excitement', I'll tell you that much.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's something.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: But it's not really what all girls want to aspire to.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think girls should 'aspire to'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't know. Looking pretty?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You want your emotion to be 'pretty'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: 'Fury'?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `Fury?!` Does `this` look like the face of fury to you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fury?![/i][/color] Does [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] look like the face of fury to you?!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually. yeah.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I come here for a photo shoot at `your` request, and you just insult me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I come here for a photo shoot at [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] request, and you just insult me.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't mean 'fury' in a bad way. 'Anger' is not a bad emotion. It tells you when something's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Now you're calling me `wrong?` I want the photos to show how `attractive` I am.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you're calling me [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong?[/i][/color] I want the photos to show how [color=#3b78e2][i]attractive[/i][/color] I am.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You and I probably have different ideas of what 'attractive' is.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, that much is `obvious.` Just make my photo 'pretty.'
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that much is [color=#3b78e2][i]obvious.[/i][/color] Just make my photo 'pretty.'

nodes.text: They walk out to the football field, and Autumn has Lindsay sit in the bleachers in her cheerleading outfit.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How's this?
Lindsay perches on the edge of a bench, her hands folded in her lap and a bright smile on her face.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There should be a point to the photos I take of you. Like an emotion that you're displaying.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The way you're sitting doesn't really show anything about your personality.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: All right. What do you want me to do then?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What if you do some cheering? We can get some exuberance or excitement in the picture.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't want to tell you how to do your job, but... Wait, I do.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't want to jump around and cheer. Do you know how long it took me to do my hair today?
She steamrolls on before Autumn can talk.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: `An hour.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]An hour.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize it took so long to make straight hair, uh, straight.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Think of another emotion or whatever that doesn't involve me doing something weird or silly or active.
Autumn looks over Lindsay's angry face, trying to decide what to say.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can represent...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm assuming you care about that.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So my pictures would be with the hottest guy in school, his swim pro girlfriend, and a football superstar?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If that's how you see them... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What about the other cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's not using them. You're the only cheerleader she's photographing.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Then I'm `definitely` in.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] in.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How do we do this?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So what? Now you feel sorry for me or something?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That's even worse!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't feel sorry for you. I just thought I owed you one.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: After you left me out last time because I wasn't popular enough?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay... Autumn didn't care whether or not you were popular.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, I just wanted the best pictures.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And my pictures were awful?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They weren't what I was looking for. The others just showed a specific emotion or trait.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Besides, the last time, I was looking for the best pictures out of an entire group. If I work with you by yourself, then I can get the exact pictures that we both want.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Hmmm... Fine. How do we do this?
After school, $ZOE drops by the photo lab to check in on Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you get the prints done?
Autumn looks at her photos of Ben, Emily, and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong with the photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not that. I was just thinking about my exhibit and about what happened last time when Lindsay destroyed the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't have to worry about that now. Lindsay's not going to try something like that again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That may be so, but...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I want my art to make people `feel.` But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want my art to make people [color=#3b78e2][i]feel.[/i][/color] But that doesn't include wanting people to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't include everyone in the photo shoot.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I can include Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure, Autumn? You don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay did something awful to you. If you include her, she might think that she can get her way if she does bad things to people.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I thought about that. But what's the alternative? She hated me for not including her, she'll hate me more for getting punished...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I can turn this Art Showcase into a peace offering. Even if I'm upset that she destroyed my photos, I kind of understand how she feels now.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No one wants to feel left out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do we have enough time?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If we hurry.
Autumn and $ZOE spot Lindsay coming out of the detention classroom.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, do you have a second?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh, well, if it's little Miss Perky and her hipster sidekick.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to sit in detention with boring Ms. Fitzpootie for an hour all thanks to you, so I'm sure you can figure out why I don't want to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She turns away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Lindsay, wait!
Lindsay stops.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm... I'm redoing my photo shoot. And I wanted you to be in it.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Give me one good reason why I should bother.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: Ben, Emily, and Owen are in it.
I left you out last time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh good!
A door at the far end of the swim center opens abruptly, and Ben strolls through.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben!
Ben puts an arm around her shoulders, and she leans into him, her face illuminated by the sudden light from the door.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's a great shot!
Autumn tries to take a picture, but realizes she's out of film. She grabs a spare roll in her pocket and hurries to...
She lowers her camera. The coach wraps up practice and sends the boys to the locker room.
Ben comes over to them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you take some good pictures during practice? Need any more?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn wants to--
$ZOE stops as her text alarm goes off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmmm... It's from Amanda.
Another text alarm goes off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And she's sending me a message one word at a time. I'm just going to call her. Autumn, let Ben know what you want.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yep!
$ZOE takes off, dialing as she runs out of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Happy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sad?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Angry?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Focused, actually.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I took some pictures of you on the court. You looked so determined during your scrimmage that it inspired me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Our game's on Friday. I'm trying to push myself, so we won't lose.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It shows. That focus is going to be the central theme of your photos for the showcase.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh. How do I pose for that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's not something you really force. What else makes you focus?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Competition. My mind's been all basketball since we lost to Willow Glen a couple weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I heard that loss was pretty upsetting to everyone on the team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying not to let that happen again. We'll be fine. I just have to put Lars and that stupid game out of my head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Who's Lars?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's a `really` annoying guy on the Willow Glen team. He's... He's like an evil version of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's a [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] annoying guy on the Willow Glen team. He's... He's like an evil version of me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Down to the lame science metaphors. He quoted Newton's law of physics on me during a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ouch. That's must've burned.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like a Bunsen burner.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know science?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used to do pretty well in chemistry... Until I found it was more fun to use chemicals to pull pranks than to pull up my GPA.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm... These are two very interesting sides to Ben. I wonder if I can use his pranking or his interest in chemistry for 'focus'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Ben's pictures?
They pore over Ben's photos...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... What do you think of the pictures so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad it worked out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Me too. And with that... I should be getting to class myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'll have all these photos done by the end of day. Thank you for everything, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let me know if you need anything else, okay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I just hope I can get all my photos developed in time!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I hope the picture will still show up!
A tense twenty minutes goes by as Autumn develops the photo. She looks at the finished product...
And sees nothing. The image didn't take on the paper.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Now I just need to shine a light on the negative to project it onto the paper...
Autumn flips the light behind the enlarger on and waits as the photo paper exposes...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And now it's ready for its 'bath'...
She turns to three shallow trays with different solutions in them.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, now I have to remember the order... It's `developer solution` first, then the `stopper solution,` then the `fixer solution.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, now I have to remember the order... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]developer solution[/i][/color] first, then the [color=#3b78e2][i]stopper solution,[/i][/color] then the [color=#3b78e2][i]fixer solution.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She turns to put the photograph in the developer solution but realizes the tray is nearly empty.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Shoot. I knew I was low on this. I hope there's enough concentrate to make more.
Autumn finds the developer solution jug and pours it into the tray. There's two cups worth.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Okay, it's one part concentrate to four parts water. How much water do I need if I have two cups of concentrate?

nodes.prompt: How much water do you need?

menu.text: How much water do you need?

menu.text: Where do you put the reel?
